title: Qenome index audit report (audit_schema_version 1)
description: Stdout object after --batch FILE --audit-indexes. Separate from the batch report; see docs/json.md.

exit_code.description: 0 when the report is written. The process can still exit 5 after this object when cleanup fails.

database.description: The --db path, or the local D1 path that --d1 resolved.

queries.description: How many manifest queries were planned.

redundancy_judged.description: False when a manifest SELECT uses INDEXED BY. Every redundant_by is then null.

indexes.description: One object per index in the main schema, ordered by table and then by name.

warnings.description: Always emitted. unapplied_migrations with --d1 when the local D1 database has not applied every migration of the wrangler config; empty otherwise.

name.description: sqlite_autoindex_* is a UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY constraint index.

columns.description: Key columns in index order. An expression key is the string <expression>.

expression.description: At least one key column is an expression, so the report does not compare this index with others.

constraint.description: unique or primary_key for a constraint index; null otherwise.

used.description: Whether a manifest plan named the index. Null for a constraint index, because a WITHOUT ROWID primary key plan says USING PRIMARY KEY instead of the index name.

redundant_by.description: Another index on the same table whose key columns start with this index's columns, with the same collation and ASC/DESC. INTEGER PRIMARY KEY means the rowid primary key.
